customManagers.description: PyPI versions pinned inline in a workflow run step. No built-in manager reads the text of a run: step - github-actions parses uses:, container: and services: only - so without this entry a pin such as `uvx --no-build --from commitizen==X` or `uv run --with pyyaml==X` freezes silently while the same tool keeps moving everywhere else. Renovate's own customManagers:githubActionsVersions preset does not cover these: its regex requires the `NAME_VERSION: <value>` colon form of a YAML env entry

The semgrep version the rule baseline was measured on. reusable-polarion-semgrep.yml and semgrep-rules-test.yml both read it out of this file and interpolate it into `uvx semgrep==${version}`, so the pin lives here and nothing else sees it

npm package versions pinned inline in an npx invocation. Nothing else reads them, and the alternative is the `@latest` this replaced, which resolves at run time and therefore gives a reusable workflow a different linter on every call

packageRules.description: Ungroup GitHub Actions so a single fast-releasing action cannot hold the whole group behind the minimumReleaseAge gate
anthropics/claude-code-action releases more often than the 3-day stability gate, so it never matures; track it with no soak so it updates

The customManagers above pin commit-gate and scan tooling, not anything this repository ships, so they stay `chore` against the preset's rule typing every dependency `fix` - the same reason the preset carves out the github-actions and pre-commit managers
